solution.p:
The reduced row echelon form
\left[ \begin{array}{cc|c} 1 \amp 2 \amp 5 \\ 2 \amp 5 \amp -3 \\ -1 \amp 0 \amp -1\\ \end{array} \right] \sim \left[ \begin{array}{cc|c} 1 \amp 0 \amp 0 \\ 0 \amp 1 \amp 0 \\ 0 \amp 0 \amp 1 \\ \end{array} \right]
shows that there is no solution.

statement.p: We know that \threevec12{-1} and \threevec250 form a basis for \col(A). Find an orthogonal basis for \col(A).

solution.p: Applying Gram-Schmidt, we find an orthogonal basis consisting of \wvec_1=\cthreevec12{-1} and \wvec_2=\threevec012.

statement.p: Find the orthogonal projection \widehat\bvec of \bvec onto \col(A).
Explain why the equation A\xvec=\widehat\bvec must be consistent and then find its solution.

solution.p: The equation is consistent because \bhat is in \col(A). We find the solution \xvec=\twovec2{-1}.
